source_binding: PROVIDER_LOCK.json fixed by consumer after provider freeze; module hash checked before import, protocol and output checked; no caller-supplied ready proof
PORT_input: raw_receipts.PORT is one complete old-plan region/global raw context receipt, or list [context,...all generated scoped receipts]. Scoped devId in lists come only from validated selected VM resId, grouped by actual region; never rewritten equal or empty IN.
scope_rule: context is mandatory for old view directory/orphan diagnostics. Omitted scoped receipts mean explicit context-only plan with port_scoped_batch_set_executed=false, never proof that scoped API ran. Partial scoped batch sets reject. Actual scoped population must equal same-capture complete-context projection.
PORT_ownership: All within/across-batch raw business equivalence and duplicate decisions remain provider-owned. Consumer never deduplicates PORT independently.
other_roles: VM_NOVA/HOST/FLOATING_IPS independent strict schema/page/type/duplicate policies; EIP isInternal native bool accepted and mapped only to old true/false text, raw receipts unchanged.
raw_derived: raw_http describes raw-source protocol, not native authenticity. capture.origin explicitly distinguishes synthetic and B_verified_native assertions. Derived validator inputs are always marked derived_validated_projection_not_HTTP and contain no http_status. They are never accepted as raw, including with forged200.
view_compatibility: Old two view names, closed params, original API calls, SQL and output columns retained. Optional VM_NOVA_SELECTION actual request is published in plan.tenant_selection_request and checked against full cross-tenant VM context; missing selection keeps its API-proof flag false.
original_question: required full original question_text retained byte-for-byte as a UTF-8 JSON string, including newlines; no reconstruction or truncation from params
